detail: Copied every received CSV byte-for-byte and verified SHA-256 equality.
Retained every source row; no deduplication or imputation.
Converted blank/whitespace-only strings to missing values.
Canonicalized numeric-looking IDs without changing alphanumeric competition IDs.
Strictly parsed configured dates and numeric metrics; invalid values became missing and were counted.
Added missing-key and duplicate-key flags; problematic rows remain present.
Added matching helpers while preserving original display strings and mojibake evidence.
Classified literal zero as unclassified_zero, never automatically free transfer.
Marked current/latest profile and latest-value fields as historical leakage risks.
Added metric availability, date consistency, standings arithmetic, and relationship diagnostics.
